rules.subject: openplc
rules.description: OpenPLC is authorised for read-only telemetry (Read Holding/Input Registers). Write commands are not permitted, blocking command-injection-style function codes (5, 6, 15, 16).

baseline.description: After 5 reads of a given register, the mean observed value is frozen as that register's baseline. Subsequent reads deviating by more than 50 from the baseline are treated as a possible false data injection and blocked, with a Modbus exception returned to the client instead of the anomalous value.
